{{Quote| There's a serious medical situation on Naboo. A family that is living in the relative wilderness of Naboo has been attacked by a number of feral creatures. Several of the family members need tending.|[[2-1b-58|Billingsly]], to a medic|<ref name="SWG:HC" />}}
The '''Zaprin Estate''' was the home of the [[Zaprin family]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:Zaprin_Estate_interior.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Larence Zaprin]] in the main room.]]
The Zaprin Estate was built at the foot of the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], near the edge of the [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]], many [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] southeast of the [[Varykino/Legends|Lake Retreat]].<ref name="SWG:HC" />

It was a two-story building of typical Nabooian design. Through a small foyer, one entered the house's main room. Stairs led up to the second floor where a gallery supported by pillars circled the room. The walls were decorated with various paintings showing landscapes of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and other planets. One door in the main room led to an adjoining smaller room, while the other door led to the stairs to [[Mia Zaprin|Mia's]] room in the basement. The room on the second floor was occupied by [[Jowres Zaprin|Jowres]].<ref name="SWG:HC" />

Another nearby building was the [[Mountain poacher bunker]].<ref name="SWG:CtT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Commando|Clearing the Trash|Naboo}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|My son Jowres and daughter Mia were attacked by those beasts outside. Both of them are sick and need medical attention!|[[Larence Zaprin]], to a medic|<ref name="SWG:HC" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of sick [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatches]] and [[Mott/Legends|motts]] surrounded the Zaprin's home. The siblings Mia and Jowres were attacked when they left the house and became seriously ill. After an urgent call for help by their father [[Larence Zaprin|Larence]], a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] sent by the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B droid]] [[2-1b-58|Billingsly]] traveled to the Zaprin Estate to help the siblings. The medic [[Death/Legends|killed]] several of the feral creatures surrounding the house to extract [[Blood/Legends|blood]] samples and create an anti-toxin that cured the siblings.<ref name="SWG:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zaprin Estate was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Zaprin Estate was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

The Zaprin Estate could be found near the mountains south-east of the Lake Retreat. Players of the [[:w:c:swg:Medic|Medic profession]] were sent to this location during the quest "[[:w:c:swg:House Call|House Call]]."<ref name="SWG:HC" /> The building was of a typical style of houses called "Medium Naboo House" which were used all over the planets Naboo and [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] in ''Star Wars Galaxies''. It was also available to players, who could use such buildings as their own [[:w:c:swg:Housing|virtual homes]].<ref>{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80006|text=Player Houses: Naboo}}</ref>
